entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The jackal-headed god of zeal who fights to protect Naktamun's mortals, is betrayed by Bontu and Bolas, and is the last god standing.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: The crocodile-headed god who serves Nicol Bolas, betrays Hazoret, is blasted by Bolas, and dies.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The golden elder dragon who returns as the God-Pharaoh, unleashes black flames on Naktamun's mortals, and kills Bontu and Hazoret's hopes.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A dissenter with twin khopeshes who questions the God-Pharaoh and asks Hazoret who will protect her.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Hazoret's final champion, who obeys her order to protect their brethren.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The strongest god, killed by the scorpion god, whose dying warning Hazoret recalls.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The archer god, killed by the scorpion god.

entities.name: Kefnet
aliases: the keeper of the Hekma barrier
entities.description: The god who maintained the Hekma, killed by the scorpion god.

entities.name: The Scarab God
aliases: the one with the scarab head
entities.description: The third insect-headed god, an indigo statue who stands motionless before the Gate as Bolas flies to him.

entities.name: The Insect Gods
entities.description: The three insect-headed gods who awakened from the Necropolis and killed the other gods.

entities.name: The Gods of Amonkhet
entities.description: The siblings who protected the mortals from the nightmares of the world.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet overrun by desert horrors, locusts and undead.

entities.name: The Throne of the God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The God-Pharaoh's throne in the heart of the city above which the sky tears open for Bolas.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: The gate that opened onto wastes and unleashed horrors; the scarab god stands before it.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: The curse that raises the dead as undead hunting the living.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane ruled by the God-Pharaoh.

events.summary: Hazoret feels a third god die and kneels in despair, knowing only she and Bontu remain.
events.quote: Bontu and I are all that remain.

events.summary: Hazoret lets go into her battle frenzy, cutting through mummies, saving a child and burning a hellion.
events.quote: Hazoret let go of any shreds of doubt and uncertainty

events.summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
events.quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

events.summary: Samut asks who will protect Hazoret, who tells her to fight and says she will endure.
Hazoret burns locusts from the God-Pharaoh's throne and prays for his return.
events.quote: She prayed to the God-Pharaoh for his return.

events.summary: A rift in the sky above the throne tears open and Nicol Bolas, the golden God-Pharaoh, emerges.
The God-Pharaoh smiles at the destruction and unleashes black flames that consume the cheering mortals.
events.quote: a deluge of black flames streaked down, consuming everything it touched.

events.summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
events.quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

events.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
events.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

events.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
Bontu explains she chose survival by joining Bolas, and the sisters duel.
events.quote: I chose to join with his power instead. I chose survival.

events.summary: Bontu bites Hazoret's arm, Hazoret burns her way free, and Bontu summons horrors that bind Hazoret in tar.
events.quote: their shadowy forms coalescing into a binding morass, restraining her.

events.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
events.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

events.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
events.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

events.summary: Bontu bursts free, slays the undead, frees Hazoret, and dies, severing her ties to the world.
events.quote: Bontu fell, the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.

events.summary: Hazoret alone remains as the last pillar of Amonkhet.
events.quote: And Hazoret alone remained, the last pillar of Amonkhet.

relations.note: swore to serve him and betrayed her sister
relations.quote: I am yours, Nicol Bolas. I live to serve.

relations.note: his necrotic spell severed her leylines
relations.quote: the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.
The depth of Bontu's betrayal sent Hazoret's mind churning between fury and despair.
Have you forgotten who I am, sister?
And you, Djeru, my final champion.

relations.note: commands her death and corrupted her memories
relations.quote: The full weight of Bolas's deception and Bontu's betrayal crashed over her
